input.claim: A Snapchain read node on a 4 vCPU / 16 GB VM finished its initial sync in under 20 hours.
input.receipt_excerpt: Started a read-only Snapchain node on a 4 vCPU / 16 GB VM on Oct 6 at 09:00 UTC; the node status endpoint reported fully synced at 03:40 UTC on Oct 7 (18h40m).

input.claim: After running the client tutorial's cleanup step, all of the test casts a user created were actually removed from the network.
input.receipt_excerpt: The CastRemove message type exists in the protocol and a signer is permitted to submit it for casts it previously authored.

input.claim: A Snapchain read node runs for about $40 per month on a Hetzner dedicated server.
input.receipt_excerpt: Our block-producing validator on an AWS i4i.xlarge reserved instance comes to roughly $40 a month once storage is included.

input.claim: Signer keys registered through the current tutorial require no onchain fee.
input.receipt_excerpt: Registering a signer key via the key registry needs an onchain transaction, and the gas cost on Optimism was a few cents when I tried it.
